_doc: #1510 The ratchet of the shell-broker migration. An app listed here still compiles libs:shizuku-adb-debug-tools (its own embedded ADB channel) and is being moved onto libs:shell-client, one app per push with a green Ship. test-shell-broker-guards.sh fails when an app NOT listed here compiles that lib or starts an ADB connection (the list never grows), and when a listed app no longer does (remove the entry). The goal state is an empty `pending`: only the SuperApp owns an ADB channel.

pending.ac_cloud-store: installs over the shell channel (pm install with the APK on stdin): needs the broker's stdin door first
pending.ac_cloud-account: libs:account SetupRunbook / PermsPage and libs:appstore link the channel
